author: Ethan
build_instructions: Extract the PyMuPDF and MuPDF source archives. Follow the included PyMuPDF setup.py instructions; set PYMUPDF_SETUP_MUPDF_BUILD to the extracted MuPDF source directory. The upstream source archives include their build scripts, licenses, and bundled third-party source. Workbench source, native launcher and distribution build scripts accompany this release. No application restriction prevents modified builds or use of an alternative signing identity.
